variances.meaning_english: a group of people who camp with their camels away from water, called أهل صرم
a resolute/decisive man, like a cutting sword

waterless land
land whose crop has been harvested/cut

variances.meaning: غير مفسَّر صراحة في هذا المقطع

entries.core_meaning_english: denotes gathering/collecting

variances.meaning_english: to gather/collect water
collected/pooled water
variances.citation: رأت غلاماً قد صَرَى فى فقرتِه ماءَ الشَّباب عُنفوانُ شِرَّتِه

variances.meaning: مشتقة مأخوذة من هذا (اسم نهرَين ببغداد، الصراة الكبرى والصغرى)
variances.meaning_english: the Sarat (canal name in Baghdad), derived from this root

variances.meaning: من الشاء وغيرها، لاجتماع اللبن فى أخلافها لعدم الحلب
variances.meaning_english: an animal whose milk has been left to pool/gather in its udder (unmilked)
variances.citation: حديث النبى صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم: لا تُصَرُّوا الإبلَ والغنمَ. ومن اشترى مُصَرَّاةً فهو بآخر النظرَين، إن شاء ردَّها وردَّ معها صاعاً من تمر

variances.meaning: أصلحته، وذلك هو القياس لأنه يجمع الكلمة المشتَّتَة
variances.meaning_english: I reconciled/settled the matter between them; this fits the root meaning since it gathers the scattered word/matter
you prevented the man from what he wanted
variances.citation: وليس صاريَه عن ذِكرها صارِ

variances.meaning: كما يقولون وقاه، أى لا نُشِّرَ أمرَه بل جَمَعَ مالَه
variances.meaning_english: may God gather/preserve him (i.e. not scatter his affairs but gather his wealth)

variances.meaning: إذا بقى فى يده رهناً محبوساً
variances.meaning_english: remained held in someone's hand as a detained pledge
an anomalous usage: 'sarayah' meaning colocynth (bitter gourd), irregular from this root's core meaning
variances.citation: أو صَرَايةُ حَنظَلِ

entries.core_meaning_english: denotes the same thing as the preceding root (i.e. gathering/collecting)

variances.meaning: اللَّبنُ الذى قد حُقِنَ (من زيادة الخليل وصفاً آخر على الباب)
variances.meaning_english: milk that has been stored/curdled — an additional description given by al-Khalil

variances.meaning: السقاء الذى فيه اللبن المحقون يقال له مُصَرَّب، من نفس زيادة الخليل
variances.meaning_english: the milk-skin (containing the stored milk) is termed 'musarrab', part of the same addition by al-Khalil

variances.meaning: قاله ابن دريد، وهو الأقيس لأنهم يسمُّون الصَّمْغَ الصَّرَب
variances.meaning_english: anything smooth is called 'sarab' (per Ibn Durayd) — the more analogically sound view, since gum is called 'sarab'
variances.citation: أرضٌ عن الخير والسلطانِ نائيةٌ والأطيبان بها الطُّرْثوثُ والصَّرَبُ

variances.meaning: فيه مَلاسة، والذى قاله الخليل فَرْعُه: قولُهم للصبى إذا احتبس بطنُه: صَرِبَ ليَسْمَنَ، وذلك عند عَقْدِه شَحْمَه
variances.meaning_english: gum, which has smoothness; what al-Khalil said is a branch of this: their saying about an infant whose bowels are constipated so he may fatten, when his fat begins to set
sour milk

entries.core_meaning: الصاد والراء والحاء أصلٌ منقاسٌ يدلُّ على ظهور الشىء وبروزه
entries.core_meaning_english: denotes the appearance and emergence/protrusion of a thing

variances.meaning: من ذلك: الشَّىءُ الصَّريح؛ والصريح: المحضُ الحسَب، وجمعه صُرَحاء
variances.meaning_english: from that [root meaning]: the thing that is 'sarih' (clear/manifest); al-sarih also means pure in lineage, plural surahaa'

variances.meaning: قال الخليل: ويُجمع الخيلُ على الصرائح
variances.meaning_english: horses are collectively termed 'saraa'ih' (per al-Khalil)
anything pure is 'sarih'
clearly manifest in purity/clarity
he declared/made plain what was in his mind
an undiluted cup (of wine), not mixed with anything
the wine cleared when its foam departed
variances.citation: قال الأعشى: كُمَيتٌ تُكَشِّفُ عن حُمْرةٍ إذا صَرَّحَتْ بعد إزبادِها

variances.meaning: أى جهاراً؛ ولقيت فلاناً مُصارَحةً وصِراحاً، أى كِفاحاً
variances.meaning_english: he brought it out openly; I met so-and-so openly/face to face
the truth became plainly clear, i.e. the matter was uncovered after being hidden

variances.meaning_english: an open space; or said to be the raised flat ground
a clear day, cloudless

variances.meaning: بيتٌ واحدٌ يُبنى منفرداً ضخماً طويلاً فى السماء؛ وكلُّ بناءٍ عالٍ فهو صَرْح
variances.meaning_english: a single tall, massive, freestanding building/palace; any lofty building is called a 'sarh'

entries.core_meaning_english: denotes a loud/high-pitched sound or cry

variances.meaning_english: shouting/screaming, from this root
he shouted, i.e. made a loud sound
one crying out for help
also the one who comes to the rescue; or said the rescuer is 'musrikh'

the noun for cold

thin cloud

entries.core_meaning_english: purity/clearness; piercing through; and reduction/lessening

variances.meaning_english: the pure, unmixed one

pure, unmixed love
pure wine/drink

variances.meaning_english: the road/path

entries.core_meaning: منحوتةٌ من صَمَرَ ومَعَرَ. أمّا صمر فاشتدّ. وأمّا معر فقلّ نبته وخيره. وقد ذُكِر في بابه.
entries.core_meaning_english: A blend of two roots: samara (to become firm/hard) and ma'ara (for its vegetation and goodness to become scarce).

entries.core_meaning: منحوتٌ من صَلَخ وصَمَل: أمّا صَمَل فاشتدّ، وأمّا صَلَخ فمِن الصَّمَم. فكأنّ اللبن إذا خَثُر لم يكن له عند صبِّه صوت (كالأصمّ).
entries.core_meaning_english: A blend of the roots salakha (relating to deafness) and samala (to become firm/hard); as if thickened milk makes no sound when poured, like something deaf.

variances.meaning_english: the ear canal/opening; the lam is an extra letter, the true word being al-simakh
thick, clotted milk

variances.meaning_english: dried dates

entries.core_meaning: الفرس الشديدة. وهذه من صَلَدَ وصَدَمَ. أمّا الصَّلْد فالشديد، وهو من صخرة الصَّلْد. والصَّدْم من صَدْمِ الشيء.
entries.core_meaning_english: A hardy, strong mare; a blend of salada (hard, unyielding, as of hard rock) and sadama (to strike/collide).

variances.meaning_english: a strong, hardy mare

entries.core_meaning: وهو السَّيِّد، فمضى ذِكرُه؛ لأنه من باب الإبدال، وهو الصُّنديد.

variances.meaning_english: the chief, master, leader

entries.core_meaning_english: A tall man; a blend of two words, saqab (tall) and sa'b (difficult/hard - from difficulty).

variances.meaning_english: a tall man

entries.core_meaning: الرجل الطويل. فهذا له معنيان: الإبدال والزيادة. أمّا الإبدال فالصاد بدل السين، وهو السَّلْهَب. وإذا كانت الهاء زائدة فهو من السَّلَب، وهو الطويل.
entries.core_meaning_english: A tall man; explained two ways: as a letter-substitution (sad for sin, from al-salhab), or, if the ha' is extra, as derived from al-salab (tallness).

variances.meaning_english: a tall man

entries.core_meaning: وأمّا الذي وُضع وضعاً، وهو غير منقاس عندي، فالصُّنبور له عدة معانٍ.

variances.meaning_english: a palm tree that stands alone with a thin lower trunk
the spout/outlet of a water basin

variances.meaning: الرجل الفرد الذي لا ولد له ولا أخ
variances.meaning_english: a solitary man who has neither child nor brother

variances.meaning: القصبة التي تكون في الإداوة من حديد أو رصاص يُشرَب بها
variances.meaning_english: a metal (iron or lead) tube fitted to a water-skin, used for drinking from it

entries.core_meaning: وهو البرد الشديد، فالنون والباء فيه زائدتان، وهو من الصِّرّ.
entries.core_meaning_english: Means severe cold; the nun and ba' are extra letters, derived from al-sirr (cold/chill).

variances.meaning_english: severe cold

entries.core_meaning: وممّا وُضع وضعاً، ولعله أن يكون كالنَّبَز: يقال الذين ليست معهم رءوس أموال، يحضرون الأسواق فإذا اشترى واحدٌ شيئاً دخلوا معه فيه.

variances.meaning: الذين ليست معهم رءوس أموال يحضرون الأسواق فإذا اشترى واحدٌ شيئاً دخلوا معه فيه
variances.meaning_english: people without capital who frequent markets and join in whenever someone else makes a purchase
